task_description.overview: Create a one-day overview plot of a seismic trace, optionally with event markers.
steps: Call plot() on the Stream with type='dayplot'.
If required, apply filtering (e.g., lowpass) before plotting.
Provide additional parameters such as interval, vertical labels, scaling, colors, and event criteria.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Load the stream from the given waveform_path, plot a dayplot with {plot_params['interval']} intervals (the x-axis is the time, and each interval of waveform is a normalized waveform) . 
 Note: 1) Save the dayplot plot to {result_plot}.
